title: Slot-pooled omission-vs-stimulus supplement built and run to completion, separate from fig04.svg
notes: Completes the plan left open in fig04_revert_spectrogram_trace_weighted_sem_20260804: pool omission conditions across ALL slot positions (p2/p3/p4 -- AXAB/BXBA/RXRR, AAXB/BBXA/RRXR, AAAX/BBBX/RRRX) against a matched real-stimulus pool, re-aligned to the omitted/matched-stimulus event itself rather than p1, for statistical power. Confirmed with the user as a SEPARATE supplement, not a change to fig04.svg's own p1-aligned p2-only RXRR/RRRR design.

outputs/omission_tfr_maps_w1500/maps.npz already did the omission side (pre-existing, not built this session). Wrote scripts/extract_stimulus_pooled_tfr_maps.py for the matched stimulus-side counterpart -- AAAB/BBBA/RRRR each read at p2/p3/p4 (9 pseudo-conditions, matching the omission side's 9 in count and slot-position distribution), same measure/window/baseline convention. Smoke-tested (15 files, 71.3s), then run to completion in background: 303 files, 6 skipped (pre-existing 'no channel segment' gap on one V182o session's V3a/V3d), 353 keys, 105 min runtime -- key set matches the omission side's 353 keys exactly by name.

Wrote scripts/build_omission_vs_stimulus_slot_pooled_supplement.py to draw it: per area, 2x2 layout (omission spectrogram | stimulus spectrogram; omission trace | stimulus trace), reusing fig04_v1_pfc_condition_tfr.py's weighted_band_mean_sem (precision-weighted, Kish effective n across sessions) and drop_outlier_sessions rather than reimplementing them -- imported the fig04 module directly. 9/10 areas plotted (FST dropped, <3 sessions on one side, same floor fig04's own area-level code uses).

Sanity check verified by rendering (not assumed): at V1 (inspected directly) and by construction at every plotted area, the stimulus-pooled trace shows the expected gamma/beta burst in the 0-531ms window that is flat in the omission-pooled trace -- same signature as fig04's own p2-only sanity check, now pooled across three slot positions.

Statistics: paired-by-session (Wilcoxon/paired-t via Shapiro-Wilk selection) test of 0-531ms window band power, stimulus minus omission, per area x band (45 tests = 9 areas x 5 bands, FST's 2 sessions do not clear the n>=3 floor and produce no stats row), Holm+BH corrected together as one family. 5/45 survive Holm-Bonferroni: MT beta (p_holm=0.0027), MT low-gamma (0.013), MT high-gamma (0.030), V4 beta (0.035), MT theta (0.047) -- MT is the area with both the most sessions (14) and the most consistent cross-band effect in this cut.

2026-08-04 follow-up: user asked to confirm all areas have the figure. FST (2 matched sessions on both sides) was being silently dropped by an n>=3 plotting floor copied from the stats code without checking precedent. build_area_condition_supplements() (the six-area RXRR/RRRR supplement, same figure) already includes FST at n=2, explicitly labelled illustrative rather than dropped. Relaxed the plotting floor to MIN_SESSIONS=2 to match that precedent, added an on-panel '[n=2 sessions -- illustrative, not a population estimate]' flag (two-line suptitle, verified by rendering after an initial version clipped off the figure's right edge). All 10/10 areas now plotted; the stats family is unchanged at 45 rows/9 areas since paired_location's own n>=3 floor for FST was never the bug.
issues: Not wired into build_supplements.py's PLAN -- exists as individual assets only, same open item already flagged for the six-area RXRR/RRRR supplement panels.
plan: If a formal numbered supplement is wanted, wire fig04_supp_slotpooled_*.svg into build_supplements.py's PLAN alongside the other unregistered fig04 assets.
